**Tidying up after 0.12.4**

- **Fewer false alarms.** The "may have more new items" warning now appears only when a source really stopped at its 1,000-item limit. Several busy Audiobookshelf libraries could set it off before.
- **Most items per section goes to 100,** matching what a blank field shows. And a Media List in a design written in code now lists at most 100 items, so emails stay a sensible length.
- **Jellyfin and Emby wait up to 30 seconds** for a response, like every other source, instead of 15.

If you run Audiobookshelf, Jellyfin or Emby, we'd love to hear how 0.12.4 and 0.12.5 work for you: [Jellyfin and Emby (#196)](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/196), [Audiobookshelf and others (#244)](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/244).
